hero.subtext: Creator Pulse analyzes your content, audience, and niche trends to surface personalized content opportunities designed to help you grow.

positioning.highlight: Creator Pulse tells you which ones matter to you.

process.headline:
From trend to content
in four steps.
process.subtext: Stop guessing. Start creating with confidence.

steps.title: Discover
steps.subtitle: emerging trends in your niche
steps.description: We scan millions of signals across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Twitter to surface what's actually gaining momentum — not just what's already viral.

steps.title: Match
steps.subtitle: trends with your content & audience
steps.description: Not every trend is for you. Our AI matches trends to your niche, audience demographics, content style, and past performance to find your highest-potential opportunities.

steps.title: Create
steps.subtitle: personalized content ideas & hooks
steps.description: Get ready-to-use content angles, hooks, and formats tailored specifically for your voice. Like having a creative director who knows your brand inside out.

steps.title: Grow
steps.subtitle: with smarter content decisions
steps.description: Every recommendation is designed to help you grow. Track which opportunities you acted on and see how they performed against your goals.

features.headline:
Not another
analytics dashboard.
features.subtext: Creator Pulse feels like TikTok's discovery, Pinterest's inspiration, Spotify's personalization — powered by AI intelligence.

items.title: Opportunity Cards
items.description: Every trend becomes a personalized opportunity with match scores, content angles, and real examples from creators in your niche.

items.title: Why You?
items.description: Every recommendation explains exactly why it's relevant to you — your audience, your style, your growth goals.

items.title: AI Creative Partner
items.description: Ask for another angle, a stronger hook, beginner-friendly versions, or faceless formats. Collaborate with AI that understands creators.

items.title: Content-First Design
items.description: See real content examples, not just charts. Understand what a trend actually looks like before you create.

items.title: Real-Time Signals
items.description: Catch trends as they emerge, not after they peak. Our engine detects momentum shifts before they go mainstream.

items.title: Personalized Feed
items.description: Your home feed shows only what matters to you. No noise, no irrelevant trends — just your next best move.
